name: When should I repair my wood fence versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my wood fence versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should repair your wood fence when damage is localized to a few boards, posts, or sections, and the overall structure remains sound. If less than 25-30% of the fence is compromised, repair is often the more cost-effective option. However, if there's widespread rot, extensive insect damage, or significant leaning due to deteriorated posts across most of the fence line, replacement is usually recommended for long-term stability and cost efficiency. We assess the extent of damage to advise the most durable solution for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is suitable for localized damage; replacement is better for widespread issues like rot or significant structural instability across much of the fence. We can assess the extent of damage to recommend the best path.
